title: Preserve work and assessment facts through workflow record changes
statement: The Work record storage Module shall preserve work and assessment facts through workflow record changes within its accountable boundary so that SR-083 can be satisfied without transferring another owner's decisions or state authority.

what.problem: The SR-083 obligation crosses guidance, governance or publication boundaries; an unowned contribution can make a locally valid step appear sufficient for the whole workflow.
what.desired_outcome: Validate and publish explicit work, gate, attempt and Verify facts under the selected supported record contract without requiring approval per milestone.

why.rationale: MOD-011 owns the behavior or state needed for this contribution; separating it preserves one accountable owner while allowing the parent SR to compose several contributors.

stakeholders: Participants relying on Work record storage
Authors, reviewers and project decision owners

conditions: When the selected requirement-first workflow exercises SR-083 or reassesses its affected basis.

contexts: The MOD-011 responsibility boundary and its declared logical Interfaces.

how.approach: Apply the allocated criteria through the constrained Functions and explicit contract inputs/outcomes; preserve actual actor decisions, subject identity and known limitations.

how_much.scope: This allocated contribution to SR-083; other contributors, independent assessment, physical recording implementation and product activation remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Publish coherent current work, review, evidence and Verify accounts under the selected contract without mandatory milestone approval or an activity ledger.

During workflow adoption preserve required original source meaning and reconcile active dependencies. During normal work permit explicit current-account replacement and selective compaction; reject unknown or mixed contracts before mutation.
Use fresh guarded coherent publication and truthful recovery outcomes; persistence must not infer semantic approval or alter engineering model files.
assumptions: The selected project contract, scope and required counterpart contributions are identifiable; absence is reported rather than inferred.
constraints: This draft allocation neither activates replacement runtime contracts nor proves implementation or satisfaction.

sources.basis: Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.
User-selected current handoff and selective retention refinement. Reuse existing identity and responsibility; no runtime adoption or independent approval is asserted.
